accounting_fix_found_and_fixed.description: plan_epoch_accumulation computed samples used as used_micro_batches * nominal batch size, which over-counts under the step policy where the trailing batch is short (10 samples reported as 16)
accounting_fix_found_and_fixed.fix: sums epoch_plan micro_batch_sizes per batch and adds samples_unaccounted as a conservation check
accounting_fix_found_and_fixed.why_it_matters: it would not crash training; it would silently misreport how many samples were actually used

auditability.rationale: without a per-epoch list of which samples were dropped, the claim 'trained on 10000 samples' cannot be checked after the fact

bug_found_and_fixed.description: a loss not connected to the trainable parameters leaves .grad as None, and torch.count_nonzero(None) raised TypeError, misreporting 'loss never reached the adapter' as a tensor type error
bug_found_and_fixed.fix: an explicit missing-gradient check now runs before any norm or non-zero statistic

final_partial_group.meaning: the trailing incomplete accumulation group is discarded and never stepped on
final_partial_group.paper_position: the paper does not say how a non-divisible final group is handled

training_order.meaning: every epoch follows the fixed seed-42 sampling order; no per-epoch shuffle
training_order.paper_position: the paper states 3 epochs but does not state whether samples are shuffled

not_run: real 10000-row batch assembly on the remote server
attention masking correctness inside a real Qwen forward

paper_shape_numbers.claim_boundary: 48 is a count of sample-visits, not of distinct samples; because training_order is none the same 16 samples are dropped every epoch. Never state that all 10000 samples were trained.

semantic_change.after: drop returns only full groups; run_accumulation never forwards the discarded micro-batches and reports how many were dropped
semantic_change.before: drop was treated identically to error and raised before any forward; selecting drop produced a crash
